answers.core: The reasoning behind adding this to godot outright is due to the fact that this, 1: engine side, unchangeable in most cases, and 2: it should be accessible to everyone using godot outright without being nested in an add-on.
answers.workaround: This feature would either be a checkbox or different shadow mapping type outright, it's usage is completely up to the developer and disabling it and enabling it should be simple and direct.

title: PSSM using stable shadow mapping as opposed to unstable shadow mapping
